_notes: Single source of truth for business facts (NAP), hours, credentials, the service list and the municipality list. site/site.config.mjs reads this file; the header, footer, JSON-LD, quote builder and every page take their facts from here. A null value renders as its bracket token (for example [PHONE]): a placeholder chip in showcase builds, a build failure in launch builds. Fill these in before going live. Never publish a value you cannot verify.

tokenNotes.PHONE: Public phone, e.g. "250-555-0100". Turns on tel: and sms: links everywhere.
tokenNotes.EMAIL: Public address the quote builder writes to.
tokenNotes.ADDRESS: Mailing or yard address, or "Serving Greater Victoria" if the Google Business Profile hides the address.
tokenNotes.REPLY TIME: Reply-time promise used in the quote reassurance strip, e.g. "two business days".
tokenNotes.GOOGLE PROFILE: Full https URL of the Google Business Profile (reviews link). Until set, the reviews link shows as a placeholder.
tokenNotes.FOUNDED: Optional founding year. Only used in JSON-LD foundingDate; never shown as a years-in-business claim.
tokenNotes.WARRANTY: Length and scope of the workmanship guarantee, e.g. "one year on plants and installations".
